title: Celsius to Fahrenheit
hints: Watch out: 9 / 5 in Java is 1, because both numbers are int! Use 9.0 / 5, or multiply by the double first: celsius * 9 / 5.
You can format two values at once: IO.println("%.1f C = %.1f F".formatted(c, f));
